rss: Household energy bills to hit three-year high as Ofgem announces 4% rise from October
title: Higher Energy Bills for Toy Factories
story: Toy factories need lots of energy to make toys. When energy costs go up, it can make toys more expensive, like bricks and plush toys.
storyBig: The increase in energy bills affects production costs for toy factories, potentially leading to higher toy prices. This change is significant for companies like BLOK and PLSH.
think: How do higher energy costs affect the price of your favorite toys?
bull: New toy designs might be super creative to get kids excited!
bear: Toys might cost more, so choosing favorites might be harder.

rss: How parents can save on costs as the new school year starts
title: School Gear Savings Tips
story: It's back-to-school time, and families are finding ways to save money on school supplies. Look for deals on lunchboxes and backpacks!
storyBig: As the school year begins, parents are seeking cost-effective solutions to manage expenses on school-related items, influencing demand for products like LNCH and BKPK.
think: What are some smart ways to save on school supplies?
bull: Special deals can help families buy what they need for school.
